task.title: Applying a Noise Suppression Filter
task.shortdesc: Reduce steady background hiss or fan noise on a microphone source.

step.cmd: Right-click the microphone source in the Audio Mixer and choose Filters.
Choose a suppression method and set the suppression level in decibels.
step.info: Start around -30 dB and adjust while monitoring audio, since too aggressive a setting can make speech sound muffled.

step.cmd: Add a Noise Gate filter above it to fully mute the mic below a volume threshold.
